requirements.quote: 1.  Create the directory `/home/user/release/reports/` if it does not yet exist.
2.  Inside that directory create the file
3.  The file *must* contain exactly six lines, one line for every “service/environment” combination found in the existing INI files (production + staging for each of the three services).
Lines are terminated with a single Unix newline (LF, `\n`). NO trailing spaces.
